{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Jekuthiel Ginsburg''' (1889&ndash;1957) was a professor of [[mathematics]] at [[Yeshiva University]]. He established the journal ''[[Scripta Mathematica]]''. He also was honored as a fellow of the [[New York Academy of Sciences]].
